description: This file defines the `SlackAlerting` class, which handles sending alerts to Slack, webhooks, and emails for various events such as slow responses, outages, budget exceedances, and system metrics in a machine learning deployment environment. It includes methods for notifications, error handling, cache interactions, and scheduled reports.

classes.name: SlackAlerting
classes.description: A class for managing and dispatching alert notifications via Slack, webhooks, and email for system monitoring, error reporting, and usage metrics. Handles scheduled and real-time alerts related to system performance, outages, and budgets.
